traits.name: Putrid Stench
traits.text: (aura); 30 feet. A creature entering the aura must succeed at a DC 28 Fortitude save or become sickened 1 until the end of its turn (plus slowed 1 for as long as it is sickened on a critical failure). While within the aura, an affected creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

traits.name: Filth Wallow
traits.text: A ofalth gains fast healing 2 when in an area with a high concentration of debris, junk, or excrement, such as a refuse heap or sewer.

traits.name: Wretched Weeps
traits.text: (disease); Saving Throw DC 26 Fortitude. Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day) Stage 2 2d8 (2d8) persistent bleed damage every hour and enfeebled 1 (1 day) Stage 3 2d8 (2d8) persistent bleed damage every hour and enfeebled 2 (1 day)

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fist +23 (reach 10 feet); Damage 2d12+13 (2d12+13) bludgeoning plus wretched weeps

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ fling offal +19 (range increment 30 feet); Damage 2d10+7 (2d10+7) bludgeoning plus wretched weeps
